title: Try list: things to try in the daily copy
body:
Things Jake can feel in his daily copy, one line each, with about how long a try takes. A ticket closes when its PR merges (#88 Q11); its "try it" step lands here instead of keeping the ticket open. `scripts/install.sh` appends a line for each carried issue at install (#159). Tick a line once tried; if it's wrong, say so on its issue.

- [ ] #63 and #64 History (about 3 min): open History, click a row (it copies), play, pin, Retry.
- [ ] #68 Private mode (about 1 min): turn Private mode on and off, see the outlined logo.

Refs #88
